name: KromiumProcessModel
description: Defines the process isolation model used by Kromium and Chromium Embedded Framework. Controls whether the browser engine runs in-process within the host JVM, in a dedicated multi-process architecture via jcef_helper subprocesses, or as an external RPC server daemon.
whenToUse: Configure via KromiumConfig.builder().browserConfig { b -> b.processModel(...) }. Use AUTO (default) for desktop UI applications. Use IN_PROCESS when explicit single-process control is needed. Avoid OUT_OF_PROCESS for standard desktop apps as it requires custom CefNativeRenderHandler.

variants.name: AUTO
variants.description: Automatically chooses the best process model for the platform. Uses multi-process Chromium architecture where the browser host runs embedded in the host JVM while GPU acceleration, WebGL rasterization, and web renderers run in dedicated jcef_helper subprocesses with their own OS Process IDs (PIDs) via --browser-subprocess-path. Provides 100% compatibility with Compose Desktop (SwingPanel), Swing, JavaFX, and SWT in both Windowed and Off-Screen Rendering (OSR) modes.

variants.name: OUT_OF_PROCESS
variants.description: Executes the Chromium browser engine in an external RPC server daemon (cef_server). In JetBrains JCEF, cef_server RPC mode requires a custom CefNativeRenderHandler (shared memory rasterization) and does not support standard Windowed (CefRendering.DEFAULT) or standard OSR rendering. Use AUTO or IN_PROCESS for desktop UI applications.

variants.name: IN_PROCESS
variants.description: Executes the Chromium browser engine directly inside the host JVM process. When running in this mode, Kromium applies defensive GPU flags (such as --disable-direct-composition and --disable-gpu-watchdog on Windows) to prevent swapchain hijacking and Direct3D collisions with the host UI toolkit.

frameworkExamples.code:
import org.daviante.kromium.api.config.KromiumConfig
import org.daviante.kromium.api.config.KromiumProcessModel

val config = KromiumConfig.builder()
    .browserConfig { b ->
        b.processModel(KromiumProcessModel.AUTO)
    }
    .build()
